reply_text:
I replied to Ilse in her #north-team thread to confirm I've noted the 20 November deadline for Tamsin Cold Chain's signed order form.

Before replying, I searched gbrain and found nothing that disagrees with that date. The search was keyword-only, so it isn't proof the brain holds nothing on this. The deadline counts as an operational date, not a finance figure, so it's fine to have in the team channel. She said no action was needed, so I didn't take any. Her message is saved to gbrain automatically, so I didn't make a separate memory entry.
